text:
Sam: starting a quick thread to agree pilot gating for the Optimize toolkit pilot (batching + caching + quant recs + eval alerts). goal: keep criteria practical for pilot customers.
Rina: sales asked for a one-pager with pass/fail bullets and rollback plan. keep it simple.
Diego: propose three decision axes: quality (eval delta), economics (cost per 1M tokens), and stability (alert noise + tail latency).
Hana: from support, small quality tradeoffs are OK if customers see ~20% cost savings and no new user-facing errors.
Ori: marketing wants a short customer-facing line. let's lock on min quality SLA.
Sam: draft thresholds: 
- eval_delta_abs <= 1.0% on canonical prompt set (top-1 accuracy)
- simulated_cost_reduction >= 20%
- eval_alert_false_positive_rate <= 1.5% per 24h per 10k evals
Rina: add a minimum data requirement: at least 1,200 eval pairs in each observation window or the gate remains closed.
Diego: for stats we'll run bootstrap CIs and report p-values. prefer non-parametric if needed.
Hana: who gets paged on alerts? need a low-noise escalation path with a manual review buffer.
Sam: suggestion: soft vs hard thresholds: soft -> notify #optimize-pilot + ticket for PM/SE; hard -> page oncall + auto-fallback after sustained breach (15m).
Ori: fallback must be reversible and quick. use feature-flagged model mapping and a 5m cooldown after rollback.
Diego: sample pilot config for console exposure:
```json
{"eval_metric":"top1","soft_pct":3,"hard_pct":6,"min_samples":1200,"soft_window":"60m","hard_window":"15m","fallback":"route-to-stable","notify":["pm","solutions"]}
```
Hana: +1 to two-tiering. marketing clearance required before promotional wording.
Sam: gating also needs SE sign-off on customer anchor prompts and PM final approval.
Rina: proposed rollout: 1) 10-day offline sim on customer traces; 2) 3-customer opt-in pilot (small, small, mid) for 30 days; 3) evaluate + SE checks -> PM sign-off -> slow ramp to 25%.
Diego: post-ramp success metrics: sustained cost reduction >= 18% and p50 latency increase <= 12ms.
Ori: i'll build a lightweight live dashboard: batch size, cache hit rate, p50/p95, token throughput, eval trend.
qa-bot: synthetic probe job "optimize-probe-2052001200" scheduled, results ETA EOD.
Sam: risks: eval alert fatigue, quant edge-case degradation, batching tail latency. mitigation notes?
Hana: mitigations: require sample thresholds + smoothing before paging; limit quant to non-critical routes and allow customer opt-out; add per-customer concurrency caps and bucketed batching.
Rina: action items:
- Diego: simulation runbook + config (due in 3 business days)
- Ori: dashboard skeleton + probes (due EOW)
- Hana: pilot customer list + support runbook (due EOW)
- Sam: final gating checklist doc (due next Wed)
- Rina: marketing teaser copy for pilot stage (due next Tue)
Sam: can we meet Fri 9am to review simulation output?
Diego: works for me.
Hana: yes.
Ori: confirmed.
Rina: noted.
